The search returned many templates but none seem relevant to flavanone cyclization. The SMILES we used maybe wrong. The target molecule is flavanone: structure: 2-phenyl-2,3-dihydro-4H-1-benzopyran-4-one. SMILES: O=C1C2=CC=CC=C2O1c3ccccc3. That is what we tried. The search gave many unrelated templates. We need to find a template that matches the described transformation: intramolecular Michael addition forming C-C and C-O bond, breaking C-O (maybe phenolic OH). The template likely is a retro-Michael addition: break C-C bond between carbonyl carbon and alpha carbon? Actually flavanone formation: chalcone (aryl-CO-CH=CH-Ph) cyclizes to flavanone (benzopyran). The retro step would open the heterocycle to give chalcone: break C-O bond (forming phenolic OH) and break C-C bond (the new bond formed). So we need a template that when applied to flavanone gives chalcone precursors.

We can try to apply templates to the molecule to see which yields precursors. Use apply_template with candidate template IDs from search results. The search gave template IDs? It gave reaction_id and template_hash but not template_id. The template_id likely is the reaction_id? Actually template_id is integer. Might be reaction_id. Let's try applying one of them, e.g., reaction_id 264979.
